Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping. 
As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too. 

About the job 
Are you a technically interested person with hard skills within heat exchangers AND have a passion for sharing knowledge and educating others? Then we believe this might be your dream role. As a Competence Development Specialist, you will be part of a global competence development team and play a key role in shaping the skills and expertise of colleagues and partners worldwide. 
 
Your job is to deliver comprehensive product and application training sessions focused on Hygienic Heat Exchangers for the food and pharmaceutical industries. You will facilitate both on-site and hands-on training at global product training hubs, with sessions typically lasting two to five days. 
 
Key Responsibilities: 
Support the development and delivery of training, engaging with process and project engineers as well as field service professionals. 
Collaborate with regional product and application teams, acting as a "train the trainer" to ensure consistent and effective knowledge transfer across regions. 
Contribute ideas and feedback to enhance learning materials and methods. 
Assess training needs and adapt programs to meet the requirements of diverse audiences, including field sales, technical support, and service teams. 
Provide ongoing mentorship and support to trainees, fostering knowledge retention and practical application. 
Maintain and update training documentation to ensure accuracy and relevance. 

 
Global travel is part of the job, approximately 50-70 days per year with 12-15 training sessions per year. Trips often combining multiple sessions to deliver impactful learning experiences and you will be away for one week at a time. We have a solid understanding for our employees need to be able to balance work and family life and travels are mostly planned. 
You will be part of a diverse, experienced, and supportive team of ten and report to Ole Andersen, a trust-based and empowering leader who leads with clear expectations. 
We offer you a role with diverse, multicultural environments where collaboration and inclusion are highly valued. With Alfa Laval you will get to grow a global network of professionals. 
 
Who are you 
We are looking for you who truly enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others grow their technical skills. You are curious and open-minded and have the drive to inspire others and continuously seek new ways to make learning engaging. 
You thrive in diverse, multicultural environments, are approachable, eager to grow and enjoy working as part of a team. 
What you know 

Requirements: 
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technical Education, or a related field. 
Solid technical background in Heat exchanger industry, ideally within the food and pharmaceutical industries. 
Experience in technical training, product knowledge transfer, or hands-on service/engineering roles. 
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex technical information accessible and engaging. 
Experience with "train the trainer" programs or similar knowledge-sharing initiatives is an advantage. 
Familiarity with tools such as PowerPoint, experience with usage of case studies, and hands-on assignments. 
Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, additional language skills are a plus. 

 
Merit: 
Experience with practical application of AI in a, for this role, relevant area. 

 
If you're motivated to make a real impact through competence development and enjoy connecting with people from all backgrounds, we'd love to hear from you.

Success in this role requires exceptional stakeholder management and facilitation skills, the ability to structure and solve complex problems, and a talent for shaping clear, compelling messages out of abstract and nuanced material. ~2-4 years of experience from a top-tier strategy consulting firm with a strong track record of delivering in fast-paced, high-stakes environments. 
Strong analytical capability, comfortable working with both quantitative and qualitative data to build a compelling case or recommendation. 
Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and priorities simultaneously without dropping the ball. 
High proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word as well as AI tools such as Claude and Copilot - able to produce senior-ready output independently and at pace.

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

jobs.description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. 
Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.
Role Summary
We are looking for an Embedded Engineer who enjoys technical challenges, hands-on development, and working across different vehicle systems. 
Scania Special Vehicles develops customer-specific solutions that go beyond our standard product offering. Within the System and Software group, we develop and integrate functions and systems for both defence and civilian vehicles. 
Our work is close to the product. We combine a prototyping mindset with production readiness, finding pragmatic solutions, testing them in vehicles and rigs, and ensuring they are robust enough for production and customer use. 
 
Our projects cover a broad range of vehicle systems, including: 

Defence: PHEV based on BEV3, navigation systems, tactical functions, Protected Cab, onboard diagnostics, and Central Tire Inflation Systems. 

Civilian: Scania Longline, BEV for mining, Super Heavy Haulage, City Door, and mixed suspension solutions. 

 
Job Responsibilities
As an Embedded Engineer, you will work across the complete development chain, from customer needs and requirements to system development, software implementation, integration, and verification. 
 
Your responsibilities will include: 
Developing and integrating embedded functions and vehicle systems.
Investigating existing systems and identifying pragmatic technical solutions.
Prototyping, testing, troubleshooting, and verifying solutions in vehicles and test rigs.
Adapting existing systems to meet customer-specific requirements.
Managing system change requests and coordinating necessary technical changes.
Taking solutions from initial concepts and prototypes to production-ready implementation.
Collaborating with different development teams and stakeholders across Scania. 

 
Our projects vary in size and technical content, and we often work on several in parallel. You should therefore enjoy a high and variable pace, short development loops, and the opportunity to work across different technical areas. 
 
Who You Are
We are looking for a curious and pragmatic engineer who enjoys understanding how systems work and finding solutions to technical challenges. 
You take ownership of your assignments, work well with others, and are comfortable investigating problems independently. You have a hands-on engineering mindset and enjoy seeing your solutions come to life in vehicles and test rigs. 
We believe you have:
A master's degree in mechatronics, physics, computer science, or another relevant engineering field.
Experience in embedded software and/or system development.
Experience in vehicle functions, electronics, or system integration.
Knowledge of CAN communication.
A hands-on approach to development and problem solving.
Good communication and collaboration skills.
Good English skills, both written and spoken. 

 
It is an advantage if you have experience with: 
Scania development processes and systems.
Scania vehicle architecture.
Vehicle diagnostics.
Electrification and electric vehicle systems. 

 
You do not need to be an expert in every vehicle system. What matters most is your technical curiosity, willingness to learn, and ability to take responsibility for finding a way forward. 
 
This Is Us
System and Software is part of Scania Special Vehicles. We work with customer-specific solutions that require flexibility, broad technical knowledge, and close cooperation across Scania. 
Our work combines technical investigations, hands-on development, and production-oriented engineering. We value practical solutions, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. 
The variety of projects provides opportunities to develop your competence across different vehicle systems while contributing directly to vehicles delivered to our customers. 
In the System and Software group, we work closely together and support one another while also fostering independent thinking and technical depth. You'll find our group to be technically driven, customer-focused, and collaborative—where everyone has a voice and a real opportunity to shape both what we do and how we do it. 
Scania Offers
We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions. 
With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally. 
Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje
 
Application
We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties. 
Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-11-21. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. 
If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Mascarenhas Murilo, murilo.mascarenhas@scania.com, Head of System and Software 

 
We look forward to your application!

Silex Microsystems is the world’s leading pure-play MEMS foundry, partnering with global clients to develop some of the most advanced MEMS products in the world.
As a Senior Product Manager in our Product Development team, you will play a key role in pushing the boundaries of what is technically possible — working hands-on with cutting-edge processes while driving complex development projects forward. This is a highly technical, project-driven role where you combine microfabrication expertise with strong project management to take products from concept to market. You will bring the experience to independently lead complex projects, guide technical decisions, and manage customer dialogue.
Read more about Silex here.
The Team
You will join our Product Development team of around 40 colleagues, including Product Managers, Process Design Engineers and CAD Engineers, and you’ll be reporting to a Group Manager.
The team works at the core of Silex’s offering — translating customer designs into manufacturable MEMS products. Collaboration is key, and you will work closely with both internal experts and international customers in a highly knowledge-driven environment.
The role
In this role, you will independently lead the development of complex MEMS products from early concept through prototype, combining technical depth with structured project management.
Customers typically come to Silex with a design concept, and together with our CAD Engineers and technical experts, you will evaluate and shape that design to ensure it is manufacturable. Early in the process, you will bring together specialists from different process areas to define a robust concept and create a scalable process flow, and a recipe for the new product. In this concept phase, you will be ensuring that all critical aspects are considered before the customer approves the concept, and the project moves into prototyping. You will use your experience to evaluate technical trade-offs and guide decisions on feasibility, process choices, and project risks.
As the project progresses into the prototype phase, you will own the overall execution — ensuring timelines are met, risks are managed, and technical challenges are solved along the way.
A part of the role is hands-on work in the cleanroom. After each process step, you will evaluate the outcome using tools such as SEM analysis to determine whether the desired result has been achieved. Based on your findings, you will work closely with Process Engineers to tweak parameters in processes to achieve the desired result. Finally, you’re responsible for the delivery of the final prototype to the client.
You’ll receive an introduction to Silex’s development process and tools, tailored to your experience. As you become familiar with our ways of working, you will take ownership of the technical customer interface, leading discussions around progress, challenges, technical trade-offs, and next steps.
In this role, you will

Independently drive complex MEMS development projects from concept to the delivery of a final prototype.

Evaluate customer designs and ensure manufacturability together with CAD and process experts.

Define process flows and build fabrication recipes for new products.

Bring together cross-functional experts early in the project to ensure a robust concept.

Analyze process results using SEM and other characterization methods.

Collaborate with Process Engineers to achieve desired results after each fabrication step.

Own project timelines, order portfolios, progress, and delivery.

Identify risks, troubleshoot issues, and ensure forward momentum.

Act as the technical lead towards customers.

Lead technical discussions, reporting, and planning.

What We’re Looking For

A Master’s degree or PhD with coursework in microfabrication/ nanotechnology.

Extensive hands-on experience with microfabrication in an industrial environment, ideally using processes like lithography, plasma deposition and plasma etching.

Strong communication skills and the ability to discuss technical topics in English. Swedish is considered highly beneficial as a lot of internal documentation is written in Swedish.

Previous experience with customer interaction, including independently leading technical discussions and managing customer expectations.

Several years of industry experience in production environments, leading complex technical projects, with responsibility for planning, risk management, and delivery.

A clear and adaptable communicator, able to engage both colleagues and customers.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. 

Job Description

Do you want to help shape the future of energy, enable electrification and secure value creation in a changing and dynamic power market? Do you have a curious mind, enjoy working with complex challenges and have a passion for energy markets? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!
The energy market is changing rapidly, increasing the need to continuously develop and automate our systems to stay competitive. We are now looking for the right person to strengthen our development capabilities and become a key part of one of our development teams.
Intraday Optimisation Nordic is a performance oriented department responsible for optimisation of Vattenfall’s Nordic portfolio of production and customer consumption on all intraday markets. Thus we have a key role for value creation and the realisation of Vattenfall’s strategy to lead the transition into a sustainable energy system by enabling further integration of renewable energy and new investments in fossil free power. The team is expected to be innovative, high performing and flexible – ready to cope with the rapidly changing dynamics of the European Power market.
The role as Wind & Battery Analyst / Intraday trader:
This is a hybrid role that combines part-time operational work at the Intraday trading-desk in our Nordic Dispatch Center with part-time analytical work in our Wind & Battery Optimisation team. In this role, you will contribute to the development of our optimisation processes, including wind forecasting, trading and optimisation strategies, ancillary service delivery, and the design of systems and tools for quantitative, data-driven decision support. IT and data are integral to all our operations, and you will gain hands-on experience with data analysis, advanced forecasting tools, and algorithmic trading.
Vattenfall’s Nordic Intraday-desk is responsible for optimisation of the Nordic Wind- & Battery-portfolio as well as Balance management and Intraday-trading for the majority of Vattenfall’s Nordic portfolios of both production and customer assets. Working at the intraday desk will give you a deep understanding about the fundamentals of the Nordic power market – the perfect introduction to our business. That knowledge will then be essential for any future analysis- or business development tasks, where we expect you to be creative, take own initiatives and think outside of the box when developing new solutions and trading strategies. IT and data are integral parts of all our processes and in this role you will be introduced to data analysis, advanced forecasting tools and algo-trading.
The hybrid role concept is standard practice within BU Assets and is highly appreciated by our employees. It offers a dynamic and stimulating work environment with diverse responsibilities, allowing you to apply insights from one area to another which creates valuable synergies.
 
Main tasks and responsibilities:
Operational work as Intraday trader in the Nordic dispatch center (scheduled work approximately 50%, which includes working early mornings, late evenings and some weekends)
Support our experts in continuous development of the optimisation of Vattenfall’s Nordic wind- & battery portfolio, including forecasting, optimisation- & trading strategies, algo-trading, ancillary service deliveries etc.
Challenge established solutions and initiate new business improvements

Qualifications

We are looking for a person with:
Relevant university degree in a quantitative or financial discipline, such as Engineering, IT, Econometrics, Mathematics, Physics or similar
Programming and data analysis skills, preferably in Python
Minimum 2–5 years of experience in the Nordic physical power market
Fluent Swedish and good command of English

You have a genuine interest in the Nordic physical power market and a strong business sense. You approach your work with a trader’s mindset and are comfortable adapting to changing circumstances while managing several activities simultaneously. You work in a structured way, communicate clearly and enjoy collaborating with others in a fast-moving market environment.

Additional Information

For more information about the position you are welcome to contact recruiting manager Markus Bäck, +46 72 712 28 18. For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact recruiter Anders Nielsen +46700 786 840

At ASSA ABLOY you will contribute to the system and functional testing of ARX, a Scandinavian security system that combines software, servers, controllers, readers and physical security hardware in environments where quality, reliability, and performance are critical.
If you enjoy hands-on testing, improving automation, and working closely with developers and technical stakeholders, this role will likely resonate.
Why this role matters
For a security system, every part of the solution needs to work together reliably. As a System Test Engineer, you'll help ensure new features and system behaviour meet the standards expected by customers, while contributing to the quality of a solution that connects software with real-world security hardware.
The role
This is a hands-on testing role focused on ensuring that the complete ARX solution works as expected. You'll test new features, verify system behaviour, investigate defects and work across both software and hardware environments to help maintain a high level of quality and reliability.
You'll collaborate closely with developers, testers and other stakeholders, contributing to both manual and automated testing while developing deep product knowledge of a complex access control system used in real-world security environments. The role offers the opportunity to build expertise across software, hardware and automation while gaining a complete system perspective that few testing roles provide.
What you'll work on
Plan, prioritise and execute system and functional testing for new features and system behaviour
Run manual and automated tests across software and hardware-based test environments, including Client/Server architecture, Distributed Control Units, Readers and Motor-locks
Build, maintain and coordinate testing within hardware-based laboratory environments used to validate complete system functionality
Improve test automation, processes and methodologies using Python, Selenium and Robot Framework
Troubleshoot issues and defects, working closely with developers and other stakeholders
Perform functional, performance, stress and reliability testing across the complete system

What will help you succeed
Solid experience in system, software or integration testing
Hands-on experience with manual and automated testing, ideally with Python, Selenium and Robot Framework
Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with developers and other stakeholders
A structured, analytical and proactive approach, with the curiosity to learn a complex product and the initiative to improve how things are done
Fluent English and the ability to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders

Nice to have: Experience with hardware-based test environments, Java, Embedded C, access control or security products, and Swedish language skills.
Why ASSA ABLOY
Develop deep expertise in a complex security product while working across software, hardware and automation within a collaborative engineering environment.
Meaningful mission – Contribute to security technology that needs to perform reliably in real-world access environments
Innovation & scale – Work across software, hardware and automation within a global access solutions business
Autonomy & trust – Be trusted to investigate issues, drive testing activities and help ensure quality across the ARX platform
Growth & development – Expand your expertise across system testing, automation and complex integrated systems
Work–life balance – Combine hybrid working with regular access to the Stockholm lab in a collaborative Scandinavian work culture

Ready to strengthen the quality of a security product where reliability truly matters?
If you're an experienced test engineer who enjoys system testing, automation and technical problem-solving, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply today and help us create a safer and more open world.

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. Your new job

It’s a plus if you also:

Worked with CI/CD, Terraform (IaC), Github Actions and cloud services 
Have knowledge of RDBMS database technologies like Postgres DB, Oracle

We welcome your application

Please also note that we only handle applications in English and no applications coming in by email. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, feel free to connect with the Hiring Manager prabu.sukumar@inter.ikea.com or the Recruiter monaka.perumal@inter.ikea.com.

As a Lead Engineer within Siemens Energy’s Modifications & Upgrades organization, you will play a key role in delivering modernization and upgrading projects for our global fleet of gas and steam turbines.
You will be responsible for the technical coordination of the electrical and control system scope throughout the project lifecycle, from sales support and engineering to commissioning and customer handover. Working closely with project managers, customers, suppliers, commissioning teams, and engineering specialists, you will ensure that the technical solution is clearly defined, coordinated, and successfully executed.

You will join a highly skilled and supportive team working with complex technical challenges, modern control systems, digitalization, and lifetime extension solutions for our installed fleet.

Lead and coordinate the electrical and control system scope in modernization and upgrading projects.
Develop a clear technical execution plan, define deliverables and interfaces, and drive activities from planning through commissioning.
Act as a key technical interface towards customers, project management, suppliers, commissioning teams, and internal engineering functions.
Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering activities and ensure alignment between technical disciplines and project requirements.
Identify and manage technical risks, changed conditions, and complex engineering challenges throughout project execution.
Lead technical discussions and contribute to solutions that improve plant performance, reliability, availability, and sustainability.

jobs.occupation: Registered nurses wanted for permanent positions in Agder, Southern Norway
jobs.description:
Are you a qualified nurse looking for a permanent position in Norway, with the opportunity to work in a nursing home or home care services?
On behalf of a municipality in Agder, Southern Norway, we are recruiting registered nurses for permanent positions within municipal healthcare services. These roles offer varied clinical responsibilities, independent nursing practice and close collaboration with other healthcare professionals.
You will work with patients who have different medical and care needs, contributing to safe, high-quality healthcare in a supportive professional environment.
The municipality is located approximately 30 minutes from the coastal town of Risør, surrounded by forests, lakes and beautiful countryside. Here, you can combine a rewarding nursing career with a quieter lifestyle and easy access to Norway’s southern coastline.
About the positions
The municipality provides a range of healthcare and care services, including nursing home care, short-term care, dementia care and home-based nursing services.
In the nursing home, you will care for patients who require round-the-clock nursing, treatment and medical follow-up. Your responsibilities may include general nursing care, dementia care and supporting patients with complex or long-term health conditions. The nursing home has long-term care units, short-term care beds and a dedicated unit for people living with dementia.
In home care services, you will provide nursing care and follow-up to patients living in their own homes or supported housing. You will carry out independent nursing assessments, provide medical treatment and help patients maintain their independence and quality of life.
In both settings, nurses work closely with healthcare assistants, doctors and other healthcare professionals to ensure safe and coordinated patient care.
Responsibilities
Your responsibilities may include:
Assessing, monitoring and evaluating patients’ health conditions
Administering medication and performing clinical procedures
Providing nursing care, treatment and follow-up for patients with acute and chronic conditions
Caring for elderly patients and people with dementia or complex healthcare needs
Collaborating with doctors, healthcare assistants and other healthcare professionals
Providing guidance and support to patients, relatives and colleagues
Maintaining accurate documentation in electronic patient record systems
Contributing to quality improvement and the development of healthcare services

Specific responsibilities will vary depending on the department and service. Further information about the workplace, duties, working hours and shift arrangements will be provided during the recruitment process.
Qualifications
EU/EEA citizenship and a valid nursing qualification and licence from an EU/EEA country
Norwegian nursing authorisation is required before starting work. We will guide you through the application process
Good English communication skills and motivation to learn Norwegian. Norwegian language training is provided
Good communication and teamwork skills
Ability to make independent nursing assessments and take clinical responsibility
Experience in nursing homes, elderly care or home care services is an advantage
A category B driving licence may be required, depending on the workplace
A satisfactory police certificate is required before starting work, in accordance with Norwegian regulations.

Who we are looking for
We are looking for dedicated and compassionate nurses who are confident in their clinical skills and comfortable taking responsibility for patient care.
You should enjoy working with patients who have different healthcare needs, communicate well with colleagues and contribute to a positive working environment.
We are particularly interested in candidates who are motivated to build a long-term nursing career in Norway and are open to relocating and settling in the municipality.
What we offer
Permanent nursing positions in nursing homes and home care services
Varied and meaningful clinical responsibilities
Collaboration with experienced healthcare professionals and opportunities for professional development
Salary and employment conditions to be agreed upon
Guidance through the Norwegian nursing authorisation process
Free online Norwegian language training with a dedicated private tutor.
Personal support from Dignus Medical throughout the recruitment process
Assistance with relocation and settling in Norway

Live and work in Southern Norway
Imagine living surrounded by forests and lakes, with plenty of space to enjoy the outdoors and Norway’s beautiful southern coastline just a short drive away.
The municipality is located in eastern Agder, approximately 30 minutes from Risør, a charming coastal town known for its traditional wooden houses, harbour and maritime atmosphere.
The surrounding area offers swimming spots, hiking trails, fishing lakes and forests where you can pick berries and mushrooms. During the summer, you can explore the archipelago, enjoy the cafés and restaurants along the waterfront in Risør or spend a day at one of the many beaches along the southern coast.
For those considering relocating with their families, the municipality offers kindergartens, schools and recreational activities for children. There is also a local shopping area with shops, restaurants and essential services.
Here, you can enjoy a peaceful countryside lifestyle while still having convenient access to coastal towns, everyday amenities and outdoor activities throughout the year.
Interested?
Contact us to learn more about the positions, the workplace and the recruitment process.
We look forward to hearing from you!
